propositions: The DC transport omits 12 methods the core requires, causing the writing reconcile pass to crash on set_entity_property and silently fail on 7+ others whose call sites swallow exceptions.
The port declares only 6 members but the core calls 21 distinct transport members, and conformance checks pass because TicketTransport is not @runtime_checkable.
A naive port conformance check and unit test suite cannot detect missing methods at the sites that swallow exceptions, making silent data loss indistinguishable from success.
DC's reporter identity must carry the username in the canonical identity map (not just accountId), or the reporter mutation re-emits on every pass even after a successful write, breaking idempotence.

Each of the 12 absent methods requires a recorded decision—IMPLEMENT via the pycontribs/jira library, or explicit NotImplementedError naming the DC limitation—never silent absence to fail as AttributeError.

Absence must be detected at transport construction time via an @runtime_checkable port with an assertion guard, and failures must be logged at WARNING+ naming the member and remote id so silent-failure sites become observable.
